You do need to do something special for the recipient list before Marketing Ops handles it. It is your responsibility to clean the list using the import cleaning template before submitting it to Marketing Ops. The handbook states:

- "It is the responsibility of the person submitting the list to clean the list utilizing the import cleaning template." If your spreadsheet/data does not meet these guidelines, it will error in the list upload [marketing/marketing-operations/automated-list-import/index#step-2---add-your-lead-data-to-the-spreadsheet].
- Do not make changes to the original spreadsheet; make a complete copy as indicated in the list upload issue template. All spreadsheet changes need to be through Marketing Ops, but the initial data cleanup is required before sending it to them for upload [marketing/marketing-operations/automated-list-import/index#data-cleaning-instructions].

After you have cleaned the list according to the instructions, Marketing Ops will handle the actual import and further processing [marketing/marketing-operations/automated-list-import/index#intro].

nodes.label: Do I need to do anything special for the recipient list, or is that handled by Marketing Ops?
Self-Service List Imports
nodes.text:
With the purpose of increasing efficiency through the use of automation, Marketing Operations has developed a self-service process for list imports, to be used by campaign managers when they have lists from events/other campaigns or to update the member status on field marketing events.

The objective of this process is to reduce the amount of time it takes to import a list, allowing leads to be followed up as soon as possible by SDR/BDR teams while minimising the busy work of the various teams involved.

nodes.label: Step 2 - Add your lead data to the spreadsheet
nodes.text:
Go to the import template [Google Sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/143REaMQLyIy7to-CFktL45TTTLZxBQRJUDIOMCA3CVo/edit#gid=257616838) and make a copy of the document. This spreadsheet template allows for quick edits and faster data checks, refer to the [below instructions](#data-cleaning-instructions) for data cleanup advice. It is the responsibility of the person submitting the list to clean the list utilizing the import cleaning template.
